expectation: Membrane ring on scattered single T cells and B cells, with brighter plasma cells. Common in lymphoid aggregates and follicles, and patchy elsewhere in stroma. It should be discrete cell-sized rings, not a continuous wash.
observed: A: broad yellow wash over fibrous and stromal bands in most cores, tracking tissue texture. B/C: sparse speckle and fragments, no cell rings. D: one irregular smeared blob. E: CD27 floods large areas with little CD20, with no clear link to CD20 cells.
why: The signal is diffuse haze following stromal texture, with no discrete subset of cells and no clear tie to the CD20 partner cells.
